To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

Cntnap is enriched in song control nuclei in the adult male, not female, zebra finch; that this enrichment occurs during a critical developmental window in the male; that the protein is localized in projection neurons within RA and nerve terminals of afferents to RA; and that these findings are consistent with a conserved role of Cntnap in neural connectivity critical for song learning across taxonomic groups.
